title: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
summary: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea is Natsume's farming sim, released on Switch 2 on October 15, 2026, at $59.99, about $10 more than on other platforms; owners of the Switch 1 version can buy a $10 upgrade pack instead. You grow crops and raise villagers' Happilia to restore Bloomfield's Spirit Trees and clear the mist that blocks the other villages. The US eShop lists an 8.8 GB download (4.3 GB for the Switch 1 version), and the physical edition has the full game on the cartridge, so it plays without a download. Natsume has not published resolution or frame-rate targets, and early reviews call the Switch 2 port rough: The Outer Haven, reviewing on Switch 2, saw frame drops, stutter and weather effects that slow the game down, and could not recommend this version as it stands.
